Guidance across economic cycles

Compare policy language and market repricing within the same economy’s dated contractions and other periods.

Did recession change how German yields responded to ECB news? On the same +10 bp one-year OIS scale, the two-year yield response was 0.96 bp smaller during euro-area contractions. The 95% interval for that difference runs from −3.26 to +1.33 bp across 37 contraction and 253 other meetings. Both a smaller and a larger response fit the data. Inspect the estimates by cycle

Loading decision records…

Does the choice of test years change which inflation model wins?

The model fitted to 2000–08 beat the 2009–19 model by 0.13 percentage points of mean absolute error across 24 US inflation forecasts. Removing the four targets in 2022 reverses the ranking. The later model then leads by 0.30 points, even though the earlier model still wins on 11 of the remaining 20 dates. The size of the misses matters as well as their frequency. Across all 24 targets, simply carrying inflation forward had the smallest average error of the three approaches, at 1.27 percentage points.

Compare the same forecasts with one target year omitted

Both models forecast year-on-year CPI inflation six months ahead from inflation and the twelve-month change in unemployment, using the data available at each quarterly information date. Each forecast is scored against the first available monthly vintage for its target. Omitting a target year changes the evaluation sample only. The benchmark carries the last observed inflation rate forward.
